title: Tier-2, Tier-3 & Rural Student Finance 🌾
description: Small-town income realities, localized micro-savings, digital banking transition, and family debt cycles.

cards.title: Local Moneylender (Sahukar) Trap ⚠️
cards.content:
Sahukar / Local Moneylender rate: **3% to 5% PER MONTH = 36% to 60% PER YEAR!**

Bank Education Loan: 8.5% to 10% per year (with zero collateral up to ₹7.5 Lakh under PM Vidyalaxmi / credit guarantee).
cards.imagePrompt: Comparison bar chart of Bank Interest vs Sahukar interest rate, emerald and red theme

choiceData.scenario: College fee ke liye ₹1 Lakh urgent chahiye. Sahukar 3%/month vs Bank Loan?

choices.text: Sahukar se turant cash le lo
choices.consequence: Debt Trap! 36% annual interest family ko saalon tak dabaye rakhega.

choices.text: Bank Student Loan (PM Vidyalaxmi / Govt Guarantee)
choices.consequence: Safe & Legal! 9% annual interest + course completion tak moratorium.

cards.title: Micro-Savings via UPI & RD 🪙
cards.content: Choti bachat ka power: ₹20/day daily chai/snack bacha kar Post Office RD ya Bank RD mein daalo → ₹600/month → 5 saal mein **₹42,000+** ready!
cards.imagePrompt: Earthen Matka (piggy bank) transforming into digital smartphone UPI icon

cards.title: 🚨 MISSION: Digital Bank & KCC Awareness
cards.content:
🚨 **TODAY'S MISSION**

Rural Financial Checklist:

- [ ] Family ko Jan Dhan / PMJDY zero-balance account update explain karo.
- [ ] Sahukar loans ko Bank takeover options par discuss karo.
- [ ] Post Office Recurring Deposit (RD) account search karo.
- [ ] Digital UPI safety local shopkeeper level par practice karo.
